meta.title: A Dutch acceptance with zero or negative quantity is refused
gaps: the plan has the buyer send POST /v1/bids, but the buyer's web-console session may not call POST /v1/bids (bids#create is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
Testing multiple distinct quantity inputs (0 and -1) separately within a single plan without separate library cases for each

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
